decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed use is likely to give rise to an unacceptable increase in vehicular activity and associated noise disturbance which is likely to be detrimental to the amenity of the surrounding occupiers and contrary to policies S.2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policy S.2.1 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.

	2.	Adequate off-street parking cannot be provided within the curtilage of the site or its immediate environment and the proposal would be likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety on the adjoining highway.  The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy T.2.5 (Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing facilities for Developments) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
